headline: Trump says he will create an 'AI Force' while still calling AI safety fears a hoax.
score_reason: Pool 7 lowered by 1: post on Saturday 3 Oct, before the 7 Oct window (stale).
importance_line: The planned AI Force and AI czar affect US defence and AI policy makers first, and the mission is unclear, so it is an announcement rather than a decision.
summary: ABC7 reports that President Donald Trump said in a social media post on Saturday, 3 Oct 2026, that the US will form an 'AI Force', likened to Space Force, and will name an AI czar, while still calling fears about AI alignment a 'hoax'. The post answers warnings from Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei, whose blog post the week before called for a slower pace of AI development, and the article says it is unclear what the new force would do.
notes: Reply story (who answers whom: Trump answers the AI-safety warnings from Amodei and Altman). Stale: event Saturday 3 Oct (calendar), article dated 7 Oct per RSS. Editor to confirm the date. Post quoted from the article; not opened directly.
